decisions.reason: As a closely related extension of the core door-and-gate business that already had its own webpage in 2018, it likely met at least minimum aspirations or justified continued support under the firm's substantial organizational slack.

Although only mentioned on the website, this product fits the firm's customization-oriented garage door range, and after only one year a large German manufacturer would typically allow more time before dropping such an adjacent offering.

This operator variant is strongly complementary to the firm's established access-system business, and with no clear evidence of underperformance the behavioral response would be to continue rather than exit prematurely.

A glazed industrial sectional door is squarely within the firm's industrial portfolio, so management would likely retain it while learning about demand and using existing production and sales capabilities.

This insulated glazed industrial door supports the firm's compliance and thermal-solution positioning, and a large firm with development capacity would usually keep such a strategically coherent product through the early uncertainty period.
Its dedicated webpage suggests stronger internal commitment and market visibility than a simple mention, so it would likely be judged above the aspiration threshold for continuation.
